newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Zairean soldiers beat up Belgian aid worker, U.N..
newsitem.headline: Zairean soldiers beat up Belgian aid worker, U.N..

text.p: Four Zairean soldiers trying to seize the car of a Belgian U.N. worker beat him up in Bukavu city in eastern Zaire on Thursday, a U.N. spokeswoman said.
Michelle Quintaglie, spokeswoman for the U.N. World Food Programme (WFP), said the Belgian was stopped and beaten by the soldiers en route to the WFP office in the South Kivu provincial capital.
"They tried to take his car and ended up stealing his cellular phone, radio and documents and beating him," she said in Bukavu. "There are a lot of isolated incidents of insecurity in the city."
Two aid agency vehicles were seized by soldiers in Bukavu earlier on Thursday.
"We are told the Zairean military is requisitioning our vehicles to evacuate their families from the city," she added.
Ethnic Tutsi Banyamulenge rebels said on Thursday they were besieging Bukavu after seizing three eastern towns this week.
